features.name: Plugin scaffold and Obsidian API integration
features.description: Set up the plugin entry point, manifest, and basic Obsidian API wiring so the plugin loads and registers commands.
features.evidence: npm run build and npm test pass. Plugin loads in Obsidian dev mode.

features.name: Image paste/drop interception and WebP conversion
features.description: Intercept clipboard paste and drag-drop of images, convert to WebP, and prepare for upload.

features.name: S3/R2 upload with watermark stamp
features.description: Upload converted WebP images to the configured S3/R2 bucket with a configurable watermark overlay.

features.name: Settings UI for bucket, watermark, and format options
features.description: Provide a settings tab for configuring the upload bucket, watermark text/position, and output format.
